snippet.description:
여에스더·홍혜걸 부부가 누구보다 아끼는
에스더포뮬러 최애 직원, 송예설 실장이 드디어 결혼합니다! 🎉

잘생기고 인상도 선한데, 마음까지 따뜻한 예비신랑 덕분에
예설을 든든하게 보좌해줄 ‘에겐남’이 생겼다며
여홍부부도 흐뭇함을 감추지 못했는데요 😊

✔ 여자가 1살 누나인 연상연하 부부 이야기
✔ 어딘가 홍혜걸과 닮은 느낌(?)이 난다는 예비남편 썰
✔ 결혼을 앞둔 예설을 향한 진심 어린 덕담까지

웃음과 축복이 가득한 여홍부부의 리얼 토크!
자세한 이야기는 영상에서 확인해보세요 💕

en-US.title: Don't be stingy! What the Yeo-Hong couple, married for 33 years, want to say to soon-to-be newlyweds
en-US.description:
Manager Song Yeseol, the Esther Formula favorite employee whom the couple Ye Esther and Hong Hye-geol cherish more than anyone, is finally getting married! 🎉

Thanks to her fiancé, who is handsome, kind-hearted, and has a warm heart, Yeseol now has a reliable "Egenam" to support her.

The Yeo-Hong couple couldn't hide their delight. 😊

✔ The story of an older woman-younger man couple where the woman is one year older

✔ Stories about the fiancé who gives off a vibe(?) of somewhat resembling Hong Hye-geol

✔ Heartfelt well wishes for Yeseol ahead of her wedding

A real talk from the Yeo-Hong couple filled with laughter and blessings!

Check out the video for the full story 💕
